query: SELECT c.id AS content_type_id, r.relname::text AS "table_name!" FROM inventory_content_type c JOIN pg_class r ON r.relname = inventory_content_type_table(c.app_label, c.model) JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND r.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = r.oid AND a.attname = 'custom_field_data' AND a.atttypid = 'jsonb'::regtype AND NOT a.attisdropped) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_index i ON i.indrelid = r.oid AND i.indisprimary AND i.indnatts = 1 AND a.attnum = ANY(i.indkey) WHERE a.attrelid = r.oid AND a.attname = 'id' AND a.atttypid = 'uuid'::regtype AND NOT a.attisdropped) ORDER BY r.relname, c.id
